data.long_meaning: The name Farahrouz is derived from the Persian language. It is a combination of two words: 'Farah' which means joy and 'Rouz' meaning radiant or victorious. This name signifies a joyful and victorious spirit. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that this name holds spiritual significance as well, symbolizing the joy and radiance found in the remembrance and worship of Allah.
